name: @avatark/social-ecology-runtime
description: Executes Sprint 12's social-ecology derivation: bounded familiarity/relationship-band evolution, social perception, separation/reunion state-transition detection, place attachment, and reference in-memory repositories. Host-neutral, database-neutral, franchise-neutral, zero invented psychology.

scripts.test: node --experimental-strip-types --test src/familiarityEvolution.test.ts src/relationshipEvolution.test.ts src/separationReunion.test.ts src/socialPerception.test.ts src/territory.test.ts src/inMemoryRepositories.test.ts src/livingForestSocialEcologyPortability.test.ts
scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --outDir dist --declaration --noEmit false --rewriteRelativeImportExtensions --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler && node ../../scripts/fix-dts-extensions.mjs dist
